cluster_summary: This cluster comprises 40 XWiki vulnerabilities, primarily server-side template injection (SSTI) and cross-site scripting (XSS), caused by user-controlled data being interpolated into templates without proper context-specific escaping (HTML, wiki syntax, or URL). Variants include incomplete delimiter escaping, bypassing the rendering pipeline, misconfigured output directives, unsafe wrapper removal, direct code evaluation, and one unrelated error-handling issue.
guideline_text: Trace attacker-controlled template text, expression strings, macro content, or rendering parameters into template engines, expression evaluators, macro renderers, or scriptable configuration evaluators. Report code paths where untrusted expression content is evaluated without sandboxing, escaping, allowlisting, or disabling reflective execution features. Confirm that the required guard is enforced on the same source-to-sink path before the sensitive effect. Treat this as a reusable mechanism-level pattern derived from 33 historical CVE example(s), not as a project-specific signature. A safe implementation should separate data from templates, sandbox expression evaluation, and disable reflection or method invocation features for untrusted input.

mechanism.missing_guard: untrusted expression content is evaluated without sandboxing, escaping, allowlisting, or disabling reflective execution features
mechanism.name: untrusted template or expression evaluation
mechanism.sink_shape: template engines, expression evaluators, macro renderers, or scriptable configuration evaluators
mechanism.source_shape: attacker-controlled template text, expression strings, macro content, or rendering parameters
mechanism.typical_fix: separate data from templates, sandbox expression evaluation, and disable reflection or method invocation features for untrusted input

sub_patterns.fix_strategy: Apply escapetool.xml() or equivalent HTML/XML escaping function to all dynamic values before embedding in HTML.
sub_patterns.name: Missing HTML/XML escaping in template output
sub_patterns.root_cause: User-controlled values are interpolated into HTML attributes or text nodes without applying HTML entity encoding, allowing injection of arbitrary HTML/JavaScript.

sub_patterns.fix_strategy: Use $services.rendering.escape(value, 'xwiki/2.1') to escape the value for the wiki syntax context before interpolation.
sub_patterns.name: Missing wiki syntax escaping in template output
sub_patterns.root_cause: User-controlled values are interpolated into XWiki wiki syntax markup without escaping special characters that denote macros or directives, enabling server-side template injection.

sub_patterns.fix_strategy: Escape all possible delimiter sequences, including opening and closing macros, and add trailing character guards.
sub_patterns.name: Incomplete delimiter escaping in template blocks
sub_patterns.root_cause: Only a subset of the closing delimiter sequences (e.g., '{{/html}}') are escaped, allowing attackers to break out of literal blocks by using alternative forms or partial prefixes.

sub_patterns.fix_strategy: Use rawResponse macro for complete bypass, or write directly to the response writer and mark the request as finished, or route raw HTML through a sanitizing macro.
sub_patterns.name: Bypassing the template rendering pipeline
sub_patterns.root_cause: User-controlled content is rendered through the full wiki rendering engine, which interprets embedded macros; the fix is to write the output directly to the response or use a macro that bypasses further processing.

sub_patterns.fix_strategy: Apply escapetool.url() to the query parameter values.
sub_patterns.name: Missing URL encoding in href attributes
sub_patterns.root_cause: User-controlled revision IDs are concatenated into query strings without URL encoding, allowing injection of HTML attributes/scripts via quotes and brackets.

sub_patterns.fix_strategy: Set wiki='false' in the Velocity macro directive.
sub_patterns.name: Missing Velocity directive to disable wiki parsing
sub_patterns.root_cause: Velocity macro output is processed as wiki markup by default; missing wiki='false' allows injected macros to be evaluated.

sub_patterns.fix_strategy: Set Content-Type to text/plain for non-HTML output; remove form-related tags from sanitizer allowlist.
sub_patterns.name: Missing Content-Type header or improper sanitizer allowlist
sub_patterns.root_cause: Non-HTML output is served with default text/html Content-Type, or the HTML sanitizer allows form tags that enable Groovy injection.
